exposure: electrosurgical cone biopsy of the cervix
cohort: 25 women who underwent electrosurgical cone biopsy of the cervix and subsequently became pregnant
finding: Electrosurgical cone biopsy of the cervix is associated with an increased risk of preterm labor, and this risk is related to the volume of cervix excised.
mod_finding: Electrosurgical cone biopsy of the cervix is associated with an increased risk of preterm labor.
